name: Stone Gate Plaza
demographics: Stone Gate Plaza serves the Crowley, Texas community in the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals. The trade area consists of suburban households with a mix of young families and established residents seeking convenient neighborhood shopping options. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers looking for everyday necessities, groceries, and services within a convenient strip center format close to home.
description: Stone Gate Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 1004 South Crowley Road in Crowley, Texas, serving the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading owner and operator of grocery-anchored shopping centers, Stone Gate Plaza provides essential retail and services to the local Crowley community. The center offers a practical mix of tenants catering to everyday shopping needs, making it a go-to destination for residents seeking convenience and accessibility. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM and a strong 4.4-star rating from over 364 reviews, Stone Gate Plaza has established itself as a trusted neighborhood retail hub. The center's strategic location on South Crowley Road ensures easy access for local shoppers looking for quality retailers and services in a welcoming, community-focused environment.
summary: Stone Gate Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in Crowley, Texas, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. With a 4.4-star rating and convenient location on South Crowley Road, it serves as a trusted retail destination for everyday shopping needs in the southern Dallas-Fort Worth area.
